

== Original and later persona-title states ==
The printed title changed from “Eject! Eject! & Imperial Atrocity” to “Eject! Eject! (V)”. The game text shown on the two inspected slips is unchanged. Both source images have been checked. The original has its own full card article at [[Eject! Eject! & Imperial Atrocity]]. Compilation dates do not establish the precise effective date of each state.
